subject.title: fix(whatsapp): suppress typing for unmentioned group runs regardless of delivery mode

question: Should WhatsApp land this narrow all-unmentioned `suppressTyping` mitigation once rebased, or wait for the broader visible-delivery typing boundary in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90477?
rationale: Both paths can address false WhatsApp typing indicators, but tests cannot decide the product tradeoff where proactive visible unmentioned replies lose their typing flash and the broader path expands plugin-facing API surface.

options.title: Rebase the narrow mitigation
options.body: Refresh this branch onto current main and adapt the predicate to `conversationKind` plus current group mention metadata while preserving the authorized-command carve-out.

options.title: Prefer the visible-delivery boundary
options.body: Pause this branch and use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90477 as the canonical path only after its conflicts and plugin/API compatibility risks are resolved.

options.title: Keep current behavior for now
options.body: Leave automatic unmentioned WhatsApp group turns with their current typing behavior until maintainers have stronger live repro or UX priority evidence.

recommendation.title: Rebase the narrow mitigation
recommendation.body: Refresh this branch onto current main and adapt the predicate to `conversationKind` plus current group mention metadata while preserving the authorized-command carve-out.

likelyOwner.reason: mcaxtr owns the overlapping visible-delivery typing branch and is best placed to compare the narrow mitigation with the broader lifecycle design.
